plugins.name: housekeep
plugins.description: Small Claude Code skills for keeping your dev workflow tidy: todo, do, papercut, command-policy (a flag-aware, real-binary-resolving PreToolUse Bash gate — allows safe ops silently, prompts inline for dangerous ones, deny+redirect where configured), audit-permission-requests (triage the permission-requests log and recommend command-policy/bash-wrapper gating), and setup-housekeep (installs a read-only local-search MCP — ripgrep-backed Grep/Glob with path-allowlist gating, and optionally wires the prefer-dedicated-tools Bash hook and audit-permission-requests log hook). All idempotent and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR-aware.
